outcome: Timeboxed surface pass delivered with open art defects.
authorizedScope: Stage 7 pass 1 standard surface and proof; no geometry redesign.

stop.userWords: Cap 75 minutes; stop editing at 60 and spend the rest on the final renders, the runtime screenshots and the report.

findings.observation: Thin bright central seam is conspicuous in three.js. The crossed sheets still read as a flat feather, not a volume of hair tufts.
findings.next_action: Rework the plume center registration and crossed-sheet silhouette while staying within the 58 remaining triangles.

findings.observation: Black rectangular hind-fringe root tabs and regular comb spacing are visible in close views.
findings.next_action: Bury or reshape roots, soften the root mask, and stagger tuft length and angle.

findings.observation: Runtime chest ruff forms two brighter strips that do not blend into the coat.
findings.next_action: Match the card values and normal response to the chest or remove unnecessary chest cards.

findings.observation: Body and inner-leg fur contains broad wavy bands. Texture flow is not yet convincing short strand fur on the face and neck or longer clumps on the body.
findings.next_action: Reduce low-frequency normal variation and author directional, region-specific clump masks.

findings.observation: White muzzle cheeks and side chest/belly coverage are less broad and less white than the approved sheet. The plume uses a pale lower-center sweep and dark crown; this does not fully satisfy white-toward-tips wording.
findings.next_action: Expand sheet-registered white masks, check the plume tip pattern against Nick's chosen sheet, and compare again under neutral runtime lighting.

findings.observation: Hind-fringe roots stay within 0.60 mm at rest but separate up to 2.55 mm in the tested hock pose.
findings.next_action: Interpolate weights at each card root from the exact supporting triangle and repeat deformation tests.

findings.observation: A 24-angle runtime orbit was inspected. Continuous animation flicker and physical mobile GPU performance were not measured.
findings.next_action: Review a continuous orbit and tail/hock animation on target mobile hardware.
